name: Nightmare Inside
source:
Hi and welcome. We are Mr. Trees.
Welcome to Finn's life! We've been waiting in this forest for decades, but finally we found someone to tell. Now you're here, you can listen to Finn's story!

Finn, a high school student, lives in a town with his mother and friends.(She makes very nice pies.)
We remember him even as a child. He was a sweetheart! Unfortunately, he didn't see much of his father as a child. But, he has a lot of friends which are adorable. He likes to play with them all day. We think their names were Guffie, Fluffy, Axy, Froggie, Foggie, Salsie. If we had to explain them:

Guffie: The purple ghost.
Fluffy: Cutest cat alive.
Axy: The pink axolotl.
Froggie: Frog laughing meme.
Salsie: The shy tomato.
Foggie: Tired from climate change.

Furthermore, we are super excited to see you. Don't miss this adventure! We'll be waiting for you!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209880/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你好，欢迎光临。我们是树先生们。欢迎来到Finn的人生！我们在这片森林里等了几十年，总算找到一个可以倾诉的对象。你既然来了，就听听Finn的故事吧！

Finn是个高中生，和母亲及朋友住在一座小镇上。（他妈妈做的馅饼非常好吃。）我们记得他小时候的样子，那孩子可爱极了！遗憾的是，他小时候很少见到父亲。不过，他有许多可爱的朋友，喜欢整天和他们玩。我们记得他们好像叫Guffie、Fluffy、Axy、Froggie、Foggie和Salsie。简单介绍一下：

Guffie：紫色幽灵。
Fluffy：世上最可爱的猫。
Axy：粉色蝾螈。
Froggie：青蛙大笑表情包。
Salsie：害羞的番茄。
Foggie：因气候变化而疲惫不堪。

此外，我们也非常期待见到你。别错过这场冒险！我们会在这里等你！[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209880/]Steam[/url]]
